authorKnownIssues: The frame at exactly t=5.0 is very bright: the blast sprite and bloom blow out the torus body for about 2-3 frames. This is intended as the hit, but a critic may find it too hot. qa.mjs flags motion-spike / luminance-jump at 5.0-5.5, all of them the hero.
Tangent plane and normal are only really legible at the front/top of the tube; later in the caption the marker sits on the far top edge and the plane is a faint parallelogram.
Comets on the curvature lines are readable at 1080p but subtle at 960x540; they are short bright dashes rather than long streaks.
The scene is quite blue and neon overall (backdrop nebula plus polar floor); the palette is on-brief but slightly less 'dark and restrained' than ideal.
The ring is hidden behind the torus for part of the sweep (camera only follows at ~46% of ring speed); the ring is only obvious at the start and near the end of the sweep.
The readout is 23 px mono, and the last hint line is small and low contrast. The formula block sits about 50 px from the torus's left edge at t=8-10.
Per-frame time varies 10-450 ms at 960x540 because the CPU is shared. The worst steady-state I saw was about 400 ms (hero and readout frames); this is close to the 400 ms budget.
Chapter title uses my own copy of kit.chapterTitle (English line offset), so it will differ slightly from other scenes.
engineRequests: kit.surfaceMaterial: expose uniforms for base-colour brightness (curvature tint multiplier) and reveal-edge glow strength. I patched the fragment source with string replaces; edgeGlow's step(uReveal,1.0) pops when the reveal finishes.
kit.chapterTitle: the English line overlaps the CJK glyph descent with anchor 'tl' (y + size*1.02 is too tight); consider ~1.3*size.
post.flash is a flat additive white, which turns dark frames into gray fog; a screen-space radial/localized flash param would suit hero hits better.
